dominant_strengths: Clean information hierarchy with clear section labels (WORKSPACE/MONITOR/SYSTEM) and consistent indented sub-items reading effortlessly
Restrained amber accent against deep black creates focused attention on active state without overwhelming the neutral palette
Badge system (Live, counts, kbd) shows craft attention to status communication and keyboard affordance
dominant_weaknesses: Massive empty main canvas makes the sidebar feel disconnected from purpose; the design is essentially only half-shown
Visually generic dark admin sidebar pattern—nothing structurally distinct from Linear, Vercel, or Supabase clones
Sub-item dot indicators and tree connection are weak; nesting relies on indent alone, hierarchy could be richer
fix_priorities: Differentiate through a signature interaction or spatial idea—nav alone in a void doesn't sell the concept
Strengthen nested project hierarchy with subtle connector lines or grouped backgrounds
Tighten vertical rhythm; gaps between section groups feel slightly loose for the density implied
rationale.norman_balance: Solid behavioral clarity and decent visceral polish, but reflective memorability is low because the pattern is highly familiar.
rationale.intent_fit: Functions correctly as an 'improved' sidebar-nav with hierarchy and badges, but improvement reads incremental rather than reimagined.
